meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 管理 Benchling 上的注册实体(DNA/RNA/蛋白)、库存、实验记录和工作流,也能用 SQL 查数据仓库,或接入 EventBridge/Webhook 做事件通知。前提是配好租户地址和 API key 等凭证。
howto.when: 当你要用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 自动化实验室数据,或让 Claude 操作 Benchling 的注册实体、库存、实验记录等模块时触发。

say.text: 把容器 cont_abc123 转移到 box_xyz789 并更新浓度。
say.note: 执行库存转移,再更新该容器属性。

say.text: 在数据仓库跑一条 SQL,统计本月新建实体数并用中文汇报。
say.note: 走 Data Warehouse 执行查询并输出结论。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use the Benchling SDK or v2 API to manage registry entities (DNA/RNA), inventory, ELN entries, and workflow tasks, query the Data Warehouse via SQL, and handle EventBridge/webhook events. Requires tenant URL plus API key or OAuth credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you automate lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API, or ask for work on Benchling registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, etc.

say_en.text: Create DNA entity My Plasmid from bases ATCGATCG and register into registry.
say_en.note: SDK creates the sequence and registers it, returning its ID.

say_en.text: Transfer container cont_abc123 to box_xyz789 and update its concentration.
say_en.note: Executes the inventory transfer and updates properties.

say_en.text: Query the Data Warehouse to count entities created this month and summarize.
say_en.note: Runs SQL via DW and summarizes in Chinese.
